description: This file defines classes and interfaces related to Bluetooth AVDTP (Audio/Video Distribution Transport Protocol) stream endpoints, including data structures, client/server classes, and service categories.

classes.name: StreamEndPointData
classes.description: Represents Bluetooth AVDTP stream endpoint data, including capabilities, configuration, and state management.

classes.name: StreamEndPoint
classes.description: Derived from StreamEndPointData, adds control interface for stream endpoint operations.

classes.name: Client
classes.description: Bluetooth AVDTP client for managing stream endpoints and signaling.

classes.name: Server
classes.description: Bluetooth AVDTP server handling signaling and stream endpoint management.

classes.name: Service
classes.description: Represents a service capability within a stream endpoint, including category and parameters.

classes.name: IStreamEndPointControl
classes.description: Interface for controlling stream endpoint operations such as start, stop, open, close, etc.

methods.name: SetConfiguration
methods.description: Sets configuration for a stream endpoint.

methods.name: GetConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves current configuration of a stream endpoint.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts streaming on a specified endpoint.

methods.name: Suspend
methods.description: Suspends streaming on a specified endpoint.
